title: Proposal Submit Request
description: Schema for submitting a governance-significant Proposal to an AGCP-conformant implementation. Proposal submission initiates Proposal Qualification and subsequent governance processing.

proposal_id.description: Client-supplied or caller-visible Proposal identifier. Implementations MAY assign this if omitted, provided deterministic idempotency behavior is preserved.

action_id.description: Identifier for the governance-significant Action proposed by this request. Implementations MAY assign this if omitted, provided deterministic idempotency behavior is preserved.

action_representation.description: Canonical Action Representation submitted for governance processing. This object is intentionally domain-specific and SHALL be evaluated only through applicable AGCP governance processing.

governance_context.description: Governance Context associated with the Proposal. It SHALL include all context required by applicable policy, Canonical State resolution, authority evaluation, and conformance assessment.

client_request_id.description: Optional client-side request correlation identifier. This is not a substitute for HTTP Idempotency-Key semantics.

metadata.description: Implementation-defined metadata that SHALL NOT alter normative governance semantics.
